items.answer:
Under the Master Services Agreement (MSA), a "Change of Control" is defined as any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of the Provider [1: "Change of Control" means any transaction by which a person or group acquires more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting rights of Provider].

Therefore, for a Change of Control under the MSA, the voting rights of Harrowgate must be acquired.
